answer: Agents bond stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations bind each Semaphore identity to RLN rate-limit proofs and nullifiers. A quill, juniper, or tundra-themed label cannot alter the rule: messages exceeding the limit expose Shamir shares that can be interpolated to recover the registered secret key. The contract verifies the violation and instantly slashes collateral, while zero-knowledge proofs otherwise keep the agent’s identity private.
